item_short_desc: Rothco’s Sandbags are designed to provide reliable protection during emergencies, including floods and hurricanes. Constructed from durable woven polypropylene, these sandbags are UV-resistant, withstanding up to 1,600 hours of sunlight exposure. Their 27 inch x 15 inch size and secure drawstring closure make them easy to fill and tie, ensuring a snug fit to prevent sand leakage. Ideal for flood control, erosion prevention, hurricane preparation, and even construction projects, these sandbags are versatile and built to last.
